name: Plugin Codegraph
description: 自动化工作流编排引擎，支持多步骤推理、代码质量重构与自动化测试生成。
descriptionEn: Structural code intelligence for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — gives the agent codegraph and codegraph_index tools to find where a symbol is declared, what calls it, and what a change   reaches, from a tree-sitter index it builds itself. Compatible with the codegraph CLI's on-disk format.
author: MingLin
